notes: mergedInto overlays onto whatever dict is passed in, not just rawProperties — here the target is a wholly separate dict. 'untouched-key' isn't one of the model's 21 known keys, so it survives; 'motd' gets overlaid with the model's own value, which defaults to 'A Minecraft Server' since `from` has no motd key (per ServerPropertiesModel.init(from:) in AppViewModelModels.swift).
